sampling: Validate 32 rounds for each key seed 1..256 and all 3 exports. Warm 10 calls per export at 65,536 rounds. Then run 20 repetitions in alternating export order, 65,536 rounds each. Public seed equals repetition + 100. Compare all checksums per repetition. Timing checksums supplement the complete byte comparisons.
